synonyms: Degeneration of white matter of brain

HP:0002451.name: Limb dystonia
HP:0002451.definition: A type of dystonia (abnormally increased muscular tone causing fixed abnormal postures) that affects muscles of the limbs.

HP:0002544.name: Retrocollis
HP:0002544.definition: A form of torticollis in which the head is drawn back, either due to a permanent contractures of neck extensor muscles, or to a spasmodic contracture.

HP:0002599.name: Head titubation
HP:0002599.definition: A head tremor of moderate speed (3 to 4 Hz) in the anterior-posterior direction.

HP:0003552.name: Muscle stiffness
HP:0003552.definition: A condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm.

HP:0003712.name: Skeletal muscle hypertrophy
HP:0003712.definition: Abnormal increase in muscle size and mass not due to training.

HP:0007281.name: Developmental stagnation
HP:0007281.definition: A cessation of the development of a child in the areas of motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and/or emotional skills.

HP:0008677.name: Congenital nephrotic syndrome
HP:0008677.definition: Nephrotic syndrome with onset within the first three months of life.

HP:0025402.name: Square-wave jerks
HP:0025402.definition: Square wave jerks are saccadic eye movements which, when recorded with open eyes are considered to be a pathological sign, caused by fixation instability, and pointing to a central neurological lesion.

HP:0025406.name: Asthenia
HP:0025406.definition: A state characterized by a feeling of weakness and loss of strength leading to a generalized weakness of the body.

HP:0030187.name: Titubation
HP:0030187.definition: Nodding movement of the head or body.

HP:0033725.name: Thin corpus callosum
HP:0033725.definition: An abnormally thin corpus callous, due to atrophy, hypoplasia or agenesis. HP:0034353.definition: A type of spasticity that affects one or more limbs (arms or legs).

HP:0000175.definition: Cleft palate is a developmental defect of the palate resulting from a failure of fusion of the palatine processes and manifesting as a separation of the roof of the mouth (soft and hard palate).
synonyms: Cleft of hard and soft palate

HP:0000201.name: Pierre-Robin sequence
HP:0000201.definition: Pierre Robin malformation is a sequence of developmental malformations characterized by micrognathia (mandibular hypoplasia), glossoptosis and cleft palate.

HP:0000316.name: Hypertelorism
HP:0000316.definition: Interpupillary distance more than 2 SD above the mean (alternatively, the appearance of an increased interpupillary distance or widely spaced eyes).

HP:0000327.name: Hypoplasia of the maxilla
HP:0000327.definition: Abnormally small dimension of the Maxilla. Usually creating a malocclusion or malalignment between the upper and lower teeth or resulting in a deficient amount of projection of the base of the nose and lower midface region.

HP:0000365.name: Hearing impairment
HP:0000365.definition: A decreased magnitude of the sensory perception of sound.

HP:0000369.name: Low-set ears
HP:0000369.definition: Upper insertion of the ear to the scalp below an imaginary horizontal line drawn between the inner canthi of the eye and extending posteriorly to the ear.

HP:0000388.name: Otitis media
HP:0000388.definition: Inflammation or infection of the middle ear.

HP:0000463.name: Anteverted nares
HP:0000463.definition: Anteriorly-facing nostrils viewed with the head in the Frankfurt horizontal and the eyes of the observer level with the eyes of the subject. This gives the appearance of an upturned nose (upturned nasal tip).

HP:0000518.name: Cataract
HP:0000518.definition: A cataract is an opacity or clouding that develops in the crystalline lens of the eye or in its capsule.
synonyms: Clouding of the lens of the eye

HP:0000519.name: Developmental cataract
HP:0000519.definition: A cataract that occurs congenitally as the result of a developmental defect, in contrast to the majority of cataracts that occur in adulthood as the result of degenerative changes of the lens.
synonyms: Clouding of the lens of the eye at birth

HP:0000520.name: Proptosis
HP:0000520.definition: An eye that is protruding anterior to the plane of the face to a greater extent than is typical.
synonyms: Anterior bulging of the globe of eye

HP:0000541.name: Retinal detachment
HP:0000541.definition: Separation of the inner layers of the retina (neural retina) from the pigment epithelium.

HP:0000545.name: Myopia
HP:0000545.definition: An abnormality of refraction characterized by the ability to see objects nearby clearly, while objects in the distance appear blurry.

HP:0000555.name: Leukocoria

HP:0000586.name: Shallow orbits
HP:0000586.definition: Reduced depth of the orbits associated with prominent-appearing ocular globes.

HP:0000750.name: Delayed speech and language development
HP:0000750.definition: A degree of language development that is significantly below the norm for a child of a specified age.

HP:0002655.name: Spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia

HP:0002684.name: Thickened calvaria

HP:0002758.name: Osteoarthritis
HP:0002758.definition: Degeneration (wear and tear) of articular cartilage, i.e., of the joint surface. Joint degeneration may be accompanied by osteophytes (bone overgrowth), narrowing of the joint space, regions of sclerosis at the joint surface, or joint deformity.

HP:0002808.name: Kyphosis
HP:0002808.definition: Exaggerated anterior convexity of the thoracic vertebral column.

HP:0003015.name: Flared metaphysis
HP:0003015.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of one or more long bones.
synonyms: Flared wide portion of long bone

HP:0003510.name: Severe short stature
HP:0003510.definition: A severe degree of short stature, more than -4 SD from the mean corrected for age and sex.

HP:0004322.definition: A height below that which is expected according to age and gender norms. HP:0008598.name: Mild conductive hearing impairment
HP:0008598.definition: A mild form of conductive hearing impairment.

HP:0011003.name: High myopia
HP:0011003.definition: A severe form of myopia with greater than -6.00 diopters.

HP:0011800.name: Midface retrusion
HP:0011800.definition: Posterior positions and/or vertical shortening of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased concavity of the face and/or reduced nasolabial angle.

HP:0025534.name: Ocular melanocytosis
HP:0025534.definition: A congenital lesion of the sclera characterized by unilateral patchy but extensive slate-gray or bluish discoloration of the sclera . The conjunctiva are spared.

HP:5201016.name: Submucous cleft palate
HP:5201016.definition: A cleft of the muscular portion of the palate that is covered by mucous membrane.

HP:0000855.definition: Increased resistance towards insulin, that is, diminished effectiveness of insulin in reducing blood glucose levels.
synonyms: Body fails to respond to insulin

HP:0001250.name: Seizure
HP:0001250.definition: A seizure is an intermittent abnormality of nervous system physiology characterized by a transient occurrence of signs and/or symptoms due to abnormal excessive or synchronous neuronal activity in the brain.

HP:0001251.name: Ataxia
HP:0001251.definition: Ataxia refers to impaired coordination of voluntary muscle movement. Cerebellar ataxia refers to ataxia due to dysfunction of the cerebellum. HP:0001513.name: Obesity
HP:0001513.definition: Accumulation of substantial excess body fat.

HP:0001596.name: Alopecia
HP:0001596.definition: A noncongenital process of hair loss, which may progress to partial or complete baldness.

HP:0001627.name: Abnormal heart morphology
HP:0001627.definition: Any structural anomaly of the heart.

HP:0002123.name: Generalized myoclonic seizure
HP:0002123.definition: A generalized myoclonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by bilateral, sudden, brief (<100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal). Myoclonus is less regularly repetitive and less sus

HP:0002353.name: EEG abnormality
HP:0002353.definition: Abnormality observed by electroencephalogram (EEG), which is used to record of the brain's spontaneous electrical activity from multiple electrodes placed on the scalp.

HP:0002895.name: Papillary thyroid carcinoma
HP:0002895.definition: The presence of a papillary adenocarcinoma of the thyroid gland.

HP:0003074.name: Hyperglycemia
HP:0003074.definition: An increased concentration of glucose in the blood.

HP:0003198.name: Myopathy
HP:0003198.definition: A disorder of muscle unrelated to impairment of innervation or neuromuscular junction.

HP:0003200.name: Ragged-red muscle fibers
HP:0003200.definition: An abnormal appearance of muscle fibers observed on muscle biopsy. HP:0003737.name: Mitochondrial myopathy
HP:0003737.definition: A type of myopathy associated with mitochondrial disease and characterized by findings on biopsy such as ragged red muscle fibers.

HP:0003758.name: Reduced subcutaneous adipose tissue
HP:0003758.definition: A reduced amount of fat tissue in the lowest layer of the integument. This feature can be appreciated by a reduced skinfold thickness.
synonyms: Reduced fat tissue below the skin

HP:0006682.name: Premature ventricular contraction
HP:0006682.definition: Premature ventricular contractions (PVC) or ventricular extrasystoles are premature contractions of the heart that arise in response to an impulse in the ventricles rather than the normal impulse from the sinoatrial (SA) node.

HP:0009125.name: Lipodystrophy
HP:0009125.definition: Degenerative changes of the fat tissue.
synonyms: Inability to make and keep healthy fat tissue

HP:0010871.name: Sensory ataxia
HP:0010871.definition: Incoordination of movement caused by a deficit in the sensory nervous system. Sensory ataxia can be distinguished from cerebellar ataxia by asking the patient to close his or her eyes. Persons with cerebellar ataxia show only a minimal worsening of symptoms, whereas persons with sensory ataxia show

HP:0012378.name: Fatigue
HP:0012378.definition: A subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation.

HP:0012622.name: Chronic kidney disease
HP:0012622.definition: Functional anomaly of the kidney persisting for at least three months.

HP:0025383.name: Dorsocervical fat pad
HP:0025383.definition: An area of fat accumulation at the back of the neck in the form of a hump.

HP:0100543.name: Cognitive impairment
HP:0100543.definition: Abnormal cognition is characterized by deficits in thinking, reasoning, or remembering.

HP:0000044.definition: Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism is characterized by reduced function of the gonads (testes in males or ovaries in females) and results from the absence of the gonadal stimulating pituitary hormones: follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH).

HP:0000175.name: Cleft palate
HP:0000175.definition: Cleft palate is a developmental defect of the palate resulting from a failure of fusion of the palatine processes and manifesting as a separation of the roof of the mouth (soft and hard palate).
synonyms: Cleft of hard and soft palate

HP:0000348.name: High forehead
HP:0000348.definition: An abnormally increased height of the forehead.

HP:0000369.name: Low-set ears
HP:0000369.definition: Upper insertion of the ear to the scalp below an imaginary horizontal line drawn between the inner canthi of the eye and extending posteriorly to the ear.

HP:0000458.name: Anosmia
HP:0000458.definition: An inability to perceive odors. HP:0000717.name: Autism
HP:0000717.definition: Autism is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by impaired social interaction and communication, and by restricted and repetitive behavior. Autism begins in childhood. It is marked by the presence of markedly abnormal or impaired development in social interaction and communication and a marke

HP:0000729.name: Autistic behavior
HP:0000729.definition: Persistent deficits in social interaction and communication and interaction as well as a markedly restricted repertoire of activity and interest as well as repetitive patterns of behavior.

HP:0000823.name: Delayed puberty
HP:0000823.definition: Passing the age when puberty normally occurs with no physical or hormonal signs of the onset of puberty.

HP:0001159.name: Syndactyly
HP:0001159.definition: Webbing or fusion of the fingers or toes, involving soft parts only or including bone structure. Bony fusions are referred to as "bony" syndactyly if the fusion occurs in a radio-ulnar axis. Fusions of bones of the fingers or toes in a proximo-distal axis are referred to as "symphalangism".

HP:0001263.name: Global developmental delay
HP:0001263.definition: A delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child, including motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and emotional skills. This term should only be used to describe children younger than five years of age.

HP:0001770.name: Toe syndactyly
HP:0001770.definition: Webbing or fusion of the toes, involving soft parts only or including bone structure. Bony fusions are referred to as "bony" Syndactyly if the fusion occurs in a radio-ulnar axis. Fusions of bones of the toes in a proximo-distal axis are referred to as "Symphalangism".

HP:0001839.name: Split foot
HP:0001839.definition: A condition in which middle parts of the foot (toes and metatarsals) are missing giving a cleft appearance. The severity is very variable ranging from slightly hypoplastic 3rd toe over absent 2nd or 3rd toes as far as oligo- or monodactyl feet.

HP:0001999.name: Abnormal facial shape
HP:0001999.definition: An abnormal morphology (form) of the face or its components.

HP:0002108.name: Spontaneous pneumothorax
HP:0002108.definition: Pneumothorax occurring without traumatic injury to the chest or lung.

HP:0002719.name: Recurrent infections
HP:0002719.definition: Increased susceptibility to infections as manifested by repeated bouts of infection.

HP:0003026.name: Short long bone
HP:0003026.definition: One or more abnormally short long bone.

HP:0004409.name: Hyposmia
HP:0004409.definition: A decreased sensitivity to odorants (that is, a decreased ability to perceive odors).

HP:0004429.name: Recurrent viral infections
HP:0004429.definition: Increased susceptibility to viral infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral infection.

HP:0004484.name: Craniofacial asymmetry
HP:0004484.definition: Asymmetry of the bones of the skull and the face.

HP:0004493.name: Craniofacial hyperostosis
HP:0004493.definition: Excessive growth of the craniofacial bones.
synonyms: Excessive bone growth of the skull and face

HP:0006349.name: Agenesis of permanent teeth
HP:0006349.definition: A congenital defect characterized by the absence of one or more permanent teeth, including oligodontia, hypodontia, and adontia of the of permanent teeth.

HP:0007018.name: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
HP:0007018.definition: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) manifests at age 2-3 years or by first grade at the latest. HP:0010442.name: Polydactyly
HP:0010442.definition: A congenital anomaly characterized by the presence of supernumerary fingers or toes.
synonyms: More than five fingers or toes on hands or feet

HP:0011297.name: Abnormal digit morphology
HP:0011297.definition: A morphological abnormality of a digit, i.e., of a finger or toe.

HP:0011342.name: Mild global developmental delay
HP:0011342.definition: A mild delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

HP:0011410.name: Caesarean section
HP:0011410.definition: Delivery of a fetus through surgical incisions made through the abdominal wall (laparotomy) and the uterine wall (hysterotomy).

HP:0012741.name: Unilateral cryptorchidism
HP:0012741.definition: Absence of a testis from the scrotum on one side owing to failure of the testis or testes to descend through the inguinal canal to the scrotum.

HP:0045025.name: Narrow palpebral fissure
HP:0045025.definition: Reduction in the vertical distance between the upper and lower eyelids.

HP:0100257.name: Ectrodactyly
HP:0100257.definition: A condition in which middle parts of the hands and/or feet (digits and meta-carpals and -tarsals) are missing giving a cleft appearance. HP:0410030.name: Cleft lip
HP:0410030.definition: A gap in the lip or lips.

HP:0000635.name: Blue irides

HP:0000664.name: Synophrys
HP:0000664.definition: Meeting of the medial eyebrows in the midline.

HP:0000750.name: Delayed speech and language development
HP:0000750.definition: A degree of language development that is significantly below the norm for a child of a specified age.

HP:0001010.name: Hypopigmentation of the skin
HP:0001010.definition: A reduction of skin color related to a decrease in melanin production and deposition.

HP:0001100.name: Heterochromia iridis
HP:0001100.definition: Heterochromia iridis is a difference in the color of the iris in the two eyes.

HP:0002019.definition: Infrequent or difficult evacuation of feces.

HP:0002211.name: White forelock
HP:0002211.definition: A triangular depigmented region of white hairs located in the anterior midline of the scalp.
synonyms: White part of hair above forehead

HP:0002216.name: Premature graying of hair
HP:0002216.definition: Development of gray hair at a younger than normal age.

HP:0002415.name: Leukodystrophy
HP:0002415.definition: Leukodystrophy refers to deterioration of white matter of the brain resulting from degeneration of myelin sheaths in the CNS. HP:0004484.definition: Asymmetry of the bones of the skull and the face.

HP:0005214.name: Intestinal obstruction
HP:0005214.definition: Blockage or impairment of the normal flow of the contents of the intestine towards the anal canal.

HP:0006958.name: Abnormal auditory evoked potentials
HP:0006958.definition: An abnormality of the auditory evoked potentials, which are used to trace the signal generated by a sound, from the cochlear nerve, through the lateral lemniscus, to the medial geniculate nucleus, and to the cortex.

HP:0009830.name: Peripheral neuropathy
HP:0009830.definition: Peripheral neuropathy is a general term for any disorder of the peripheral nervous system. The main clinical features used to classify peripheral neuropathy are distribution, type (mainly demyelinating versus mainly axonal), duration, and course.

HP:0011843.name: Abnormal musculoskeletal physiology
HP:0011843.definition: An abnormality of the function of the skeletal system.

HP:0012759.name: Neurodevelopmental abnormality
HP:0012759.definition: A deviation from normal of the neurological development of a child, which may include any or all of the aspects of the development of personal, social, gross or fine motor, and cognitive abilities.

HP:0001328.definition: Impairment of certain skills such as reading or writing, coordination, self-control, or attention that interfere with the ability to learn. The impairment is not related to a global deficiency of intelligence.

HP:0001332.name: Dystonia
HP:0001332.definition: An abnormally increased muscular tone that causes fixed abnormal postures. There is a slow, intermittent twisting motion that leads to exaggerated turning and posture of the extremities and trunk.

HP:0001396.name: Cholestasis
HP:0001396.definition: Impairment of bile flow due to obstruction in bile ducts.

HP:0001510.definition: A deficiency or slowing down of growth pre- and postnatally.

HP:0001622.definition: The birth of a baby of less than 37 weeks of gestational age.

HP:0001638.name: Cardiomyopathy
HP:0001638.definition: A myocardial disorder in which the heart muscle is structurally and functionally abnormal, in the absence of coronary artery disease, hypertension, valvular disease and congenital heart disease sufficient to cause the observed myocardial abnormality.

HP:0001761.name: Pes cavus
HP:0001761.definition: An increase in height of the medial longitudinal arch of the foot that does not flatten on weight bearing (i.e., a distinctly hollow form of the sole of the foot when it is bearing weight).

HP:0002076.name: Migraine
HP:0002076.definition: Migraine is a chronic neurological disorder characterized by episodic attacks of headache and associated symptoms.

HP:0002098.name: Respiratory distress

HP:0002460.name: Distal muscle weakness
HP:0002460.definition: Reduced strength of the musculature of the distal extremities.

HP:0002835.name: Aspiration
HP:0002835.definition: Inspiration of a foreign object into the airway.

HP:0003128.name: Lactic acidosis
HP:0003128.definition: An abnormal buildup of lactic acid in the body, leading to acidification of the blood and other bodily fluids.

HP:0003355.name: Aminoaciduria
HP:0003355.definition: An increased concentration of an amino acid in the urine.

HP:0003477.name: Peripheral axonal neuropathy
HP:0003477.definition: An abnormality characterized by disruption of the normal functioning of peripheral axons.

HP:0003691.name: Scapular winging
HP:0003691.definition: Abnormal protrusion of the scapula away from the surface of the back.

HP:0003693.name: Distal amyotrophy
HP:0003693.definition: Muscular atrophy affecting muscles in the distal portions of the extremities.
synonyms: Distal amyotrophy, especially of the hands and feet

HP:0003777.name: Pili torti
HP:0003777.definition: Pili (from Latin pilus, hair) torti (from Latin tortus, twisted) refers to short and brittle hairs that appear flattened and twisted when viewed through a microscope.

HP:0004373.name: Focal dystonia
HP:0004373.definition: A type of dystonia that is localized to a specific part of the body.

HP:0005216.name: Impaired mastication
HP:0005216.definition: An abnormal reduction in the ability to masticate (chew), i.e., in the ability to crush and ground food in preparation for swallowing.

HP:0008542.name: Low-frequency hearing loss
HP:0008542.definition: A type of hearing impairment affecting primarily the low frequencies of sound (125 Hz to 1000 Hz).

HP:0008677.name: Congenital nephrotic syndrome
HP:0008677.definition: Nephrotic syndrome with onset within the first three months of life.

HP:0009830.name: Peripheral neuropathy
HP:0009830.definition: Peripheral neuropathy is a general term for any disorder of the peripheral nervous system. The main clinical features used to classify peripheral neuropathy are distribution, type (mainly demyelinating versus mainly axonal), duration, and course.

HP:0012735.name: Cough
HP:0012735.definition: A sudden, audible expulsion of air from the lungs through a partially closed glottis, preceded by inhalation.

HP:0025406.name: Asthenia
HP:0025406.definition: A state characterized by a feeling of weakness and loss of strength leading to a generalized weakness of the body.

HP:0030842.name: Choking episodes
HP:0030842.definition: Incidents in which a piece of food or other objects get stuck in the upper airway and provoke coughing, gagging, inability to talk, and difficulty breathing.

HP:0031500.name: Abdominal mass
HP:0031500.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the abdomen.

HP:0033044.name: Motor regression
HP:0033044.definition: Loss of previously achieved motor skills, as manifested by loss of developmental motor milestones.

HP:0033685.name: Fiber type grouping
HP:0033685.definition: An abnormal distribution of muscle fiber types in muscle tissue. Human skeletal muscle contains at least two fiber types recognizable by histochemical techniques. HP:0034045.name: Angulated muscle fibers

HP:0034392.name: Joint contracture
HP:0034392.definition: A limitation in the passive range of motion of a joint resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin. HP:0034398.name: Toe deformity
HP:0034398.definition: Abnormal positioning of toe phalanges. Deformities of the lesser toes often occur gradually, though they can be brought on by trauma. The main adult sagittal plane deformities consist of claw toes, hammer toes and mallet toes. Axial plane deformities include crossover toes.

HP:0100022.name: Abnormality of movement
HP:0100022.definition: An abnormality of movement with a neurological basis characterized by changes in coordination and speed of voluntary movements.

HP:0100702.name: Arachnoid cyst
HP:0100702.definition: An extra-parenchymal and intra-arachnoidal collection of fluid with a composition similar to that of cerebrospinal fluid.

HP:0410018.definition: Increased susceptibility to ear infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of ear infections.

HP:0000545.name: Myopia

HP:0000568.name: Microphthalmia

HP:0000639.name: Nystagmus

HP:0002664.name: Neoplasm
HP:0002664.definition: An organ or organ-system abnormality that consists of uncontrolled autonomous cell-proliferation which can occur in any part of the body as a benign or malignant neoplasm (tumor).

HP:0003552.name: Muscle stiffness
HP:0003552.definition: A condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm.

HP:0011986.name: Ectopic ossification
HP:0011986.definition: Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue, i.e., the presence of bone in soft tissue where bone normally does not exist.

HP:0012531.name: Pain
HP:0012531.definition: An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience associated with actual or potential tissue damage, or described in terms of such damage.

HP:0012532.name: Chronic pain
HP:0012532.definition: Persistent pain, usually defined as pain that has lasted longer than 3 to 6 months.

HP:0031013.name: Ankylosis
HP:0031013.definition: A reduction of joint mobility resulting from changes involving the articular surfaces.

HP:0031500.name: Abdominal mass
HP:0031500.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the abdomen.

HP:0000218.name: High palate

HP:0000252.name: Microcephaly
HP:0000252.definition: Head circumference below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender.

HP:0000286.name: Epicanthus
HP:0000286.definition: A fold of skin starting above the medial aspect of the upper eyelid and arching downward to cover, pass in front of and lateral to the medial canthus.

HP:0001249.name: Intellectual disability
HP:0001249.definition: The term intellectual disability or intellectual developmental disorder is used to describe significantly sub-average intellectual and adaptive functioning based on clinical assessment and as measured by individually administered, appropriately normed, standardized and validated tests of intellectua

HP:0001270.name: Motor delay
HP:0001270.definition: A type of Developmental delay characterized by a delay in acquiring motor skills.
synonyms: Delay in development of motor milestones

HP:0001276.name: Hypertonia
HP:0001276.definition: A condition in which there is increased muscle tone so that arms or legs, for example, are stiff and difficult to move.

HP:0001999.name: Abnormal facial shape
HP:0001999.definition: An abnormal morphology (form) of the face or its components.

HP:0002360.name: Sleep disturbance
HP:0002360.definition: An abnormal pattern in the quality, quantity, or characteristics of sleep.

HP:0009879.name: Simplified gyral pattern
HP:0009879.definition: An abnormality of the cerebral cortex with fewer gyri but with normal cortical thickness. This pattern is usually often associated with congenital microcephaly.

HP:0010864.name: Severe intellectual disability
HP:0010864.definition: Severe intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by severely sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) the range of 20-34.

HP:0011451.name: Primary microcephaly
HP:0011451.definition: Head circumference below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender at birth.

HP:0012443.name: Abnormal brain morphology
HP:0012443.definition: A structural abnormality of the brain, which has as its parts the forebrain, midbrain, and hindbrain.

HP:0033725.name: Thin corpus callosum
HP:0033725.definition: An abnormally thin corpus callous, due to atrophy, hypoplasia or agenesis. HP:0040196.name: Mild microcephaly
HP:0040196.definition: Decreased occipito-frontal (head) circumference (OFC). For the microcephaly OFC must be between -3 SD and -2 SD compared to appropriate, age matched, normal standards (i.e. -3 SD <= OFC < -2 SD).

HP:0000407.definition: A type of hearing impairment in one or both ears related to an abnormal functionality of the cochlear nerve.

HP:0000448.definition: Distance between subnasale and pronasale more than two standard deviations above the mean, or alternatively, an apparently increased anterior protrusion of the nasal tip.

HP:0000490.name: Deeply set eye
HP:0000490.definition: An eye that is more deeply recessed into the plane of the face than is typical.

HP:0000518.name: Cataract
HP:0000518.definition: A cataract is an opacity or clouding that develops in the crystalline lens of the eye or in its capsule.
synonyms: Clouding of the lens of the eye

HP:0000568.name: Microphthalmia
HP:0000568.definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by abnormal smallness of one or both eyes.

HP:0000819.name: Diabetes mellitus
HP:0000819.definition: A group of abnormalities characterized by hyperglycemia and glucose intolerance.

HP:0000992.name: Cutaneous photosensitivity
HP:0000992.definition: An increased sensitivity of the skin to light. Photosensitivity may result in a rash upon exposure to the sun (which is known as photodermatosis). Photosensitivity can be diagnosed by phototests in which light is shone on small areas of skin.

HP:0001249.name: Intellectual disability
HP:0001249.definition: The term intellectual disability or intellectual developmental disorder is used to describe significantly sub-average intellectual and adaptive functioning based on clinical assessment and as measured by individually administered, appropriately normed, standardized and validated tests of intellectua

HP:0001263.name: Global developmental delay
HP:0001263.definition: A delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child, including motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and emotional skills. This term should only be used to describe children younger than five years of age.

HP:0001321.name: Cerebellar hypoplasia
HP:0001321.definition: Cerebellar hypoplasia is a descriptive term implying a cerebellum with a reduced volume, but a normal shape and is stable over time.

HP:0001510.name: Growth delay
HP:0001510.definition: A deficiency or slowing down of growth pre- and postnatally.

HP:0002180.name: Neurodegeneration
HP:0002180.definition: Progressive loss of neural cells and tissue.

HP:0002650.name: Scoliosis
HP:0002650.definition: The presence of an abnormal lateral curvature of the spine.
synonyms: Cobb angle greater than ten degrees

HP:0002808.name: Kyphosis
HP:0002808.definition: Exaggerated anterior convexity of the thoracic vertebral column.

HP:0004322.definition: A height below that which is expected according to age and gender norms. HP:0004326.definition: Severe weight loss, wasting of muscle, loss of appetite, and general debility related to a chronic disease.

HP:0005671.name: Bilateral intracerebral calcifications
HP:0005671.definition: Deposition of calcium salts on both sides of the cerebrum.

HP:0008897.name: Postnatal growth retardation
HP:0008897.definition: Slow or limited growth after birth.

HP:0010876.name: Abnormal circulating protein concentration
HP:0010876.definition: An abnormal level of a circulating protein in the blood.

HP:0012704.name: Widened subarachnoid space
HP:0012704.definition: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater.

HP:0034392.name: Joint contracture
HP:0034392.definition: A limitation in the passive range of motion of a joint resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin. A contracture prevents movement of the associated body part.

HP:0000479.definition: A structural abnormality of the retina.

HP:0000572.definition: Loss of visual acuity (implying that vision was better at a certain time point in life). Otherwise the term reduced visual acuity should be used (or a subclass of that).

HP:0000613.definition: Excessive sensitivity to light with the sensation of discomfort or pain in the eyes due to exposure to bright light.
synonyms: Extreme sensitivity of the eyes to light

HP:0000639.name: Nystagmus
HP:0000639.definition: Rhythmic, involuntary oscillations of one or both eyes related to abnormality in fixation, conjugate gaze, or vestibular mechanisms.

HP:0000662.name: Nyctalopia
HP:0000662.definition: Inability to see well at night or in poor light.

HP:0001000.name: Abnormal skin pigmentation
HP:0001000.definition: An abnormality of the pigmentation of the skin.

HP:0001105.definition: A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and neurosensory retinal cells.

HP:0031609.name: Macular geographic atrophy
HP:0031609.definition: Chronic progressive degeneration of the macula that can be seen as part of late-stage age-related macular degeneration (AMD).

HP:0001279.definition: A transient loss of consciousness (i.e., characterized by a rapid onset, a short duration, and a spontaneous and complete recovery) due to cerebral hypoperfusion.

HP:0001638.definition: A myocardial disorder in which the heart muscle is structurally and functionally abnormal, in the absence of coronary artery disease, hypertension, valvular disease and congenital heart disease sufficient to cause the observed myocardial abnormality.

HP:0001645.name: Sudden cardiac death
HP:0001645.definition: The heart suddenly and unexpectedly stops beating resulting in death within a short time period (generally within 1 h of symptom onset).

HP:0001663.name: Ventricular fibrillation
HP:0001663.definition: Uncontrolled contractions of muscles fibers in the left ventricle not producing contraction of the left ventricle. HP:0001695.name: Cardiac arrest
HP:0001695.definition: An abrupt loss of heart function.

HP:0002719.name: Recurrent infections
HP:0002719.definition: Increased susceptibility to infections as manifested by repeated bouts of infection.

HP:0002835.name: Aspiration
HP:0002835.definition: Inspiration of a foreign object into the airway.

HP:0004756.name: Ventricular tachycardia
HP:0004756.definition: A tachycardia originating in the ventricles characterized by rapid heart rate (over 100 beats per minute) and broad QRS complexes (over 120 ms).

HP:0004758.name: Effort-induced polymorphic ventricular tachycardia
HP:0004758.definition: Polymorphic ventricular arrhythmias of varying morphologythat do not exist under resting conditions but appear only upon physical exercise or catecholamine administration.

HP:0011663.name: Right ventricular cardiomyopathy
HP:0011663.definition: Right ventricular dysfunction (global or regional) with functional and morphological right ventricular abnormalities, with or without left ventricular disease.

HP:0011675.name: Arrhythmia
HP:0011675.definition: Any cardiac rhythm other than the normal sinus rhythm. Such a rhythm may be either of sinus or ectopic origin and either regular or irregular. An arrhythmia may be due to a disturbance in impulse formation or conduction or both.

HP:0011712.name: Complete right bundle branch block
HP:0011712.definition: A conduction block of the right branch of the bundle of His. This manifests as a prolongation of the QRS complex (greater than 0.12 s) with delayed activation of the right ventricle and terminal delay on the EKG.

HP:0031677.name: Polymorphic ventricular tachycardia
HP:0031677.definition: A type of ventricular tachycardia that is characterized by variable QRS complexes within each lead (i.e., QRS complexes may be different from beat to beat).

HP:0034040.name: Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia
HP:0034040.definition: Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia (BDVT) is a regular ventricular tachyarrhythmia (VT) with two different QRS morphologies alternating at a rate typically between 140 and 180 bpm.

HP:0034722.name: Sarcoplasmic bodies
HP:0034722.definition: Rounded or oval structures that appeared brown on hematoxylin and eosin and red on the modified Gomori trichrome stain.

HP:4000007.name: Bronchoconstriction
HP:4000007.definition: Tightening of smooth muscle surrounding the bronchi and bronchioles with consequent wheezing and shortness of breath.

HP:0001256.definition: Mild intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by mildly sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) the range of 50-69.

HP:0001328.definition: Impairment of certain skills such as reading or writing, coordination, self-control, or attention that interfere with the ability to learn. The impairment is not related to a global deficiency of intelligence.

HP:0001622.name: Premature birth
HP:0001622.definition: The birth of a baby of less than 37 weeks of gestational age.

HP:0002652.name: Skeletal dysplasia
HP:0002652.definition: A general term describing features characterized by abnormal development of bones and connective tissues.

HP:0002938.definition: An abnormal accentuation of the inward curvature of the spine in the lumbar region.

HP:0002970.name: Genu varum
HP:0002970.definition: A positional abnormality marked by outward bowing of the legs in which the knees stay wide apart when a person stands with the feet and ankles together.

HP:0003015.name: Flared metaphysis
HP:0003015.definition: The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of one or more long bones.
synonyms: Flared wide portion of long bone
marked metaphyseal flaring of long bones

HP:0003025.name: Metaphyseal irregularity
HP:0003025.definition: Irregularity of the normally smooth surface of the metaphyses.

HP:0003026.name: Short long bone
HP:0003026.definition: One or more abnormally short long bone.

HP:0003498.name: Disproportionate short stature
HP:0003498.definition: A kind of short stature in which different regions of the body are shortened to differing extents.

HP:0003502.name: Mild short stature
HP:0003502.definition: A mild degree of short stature, more than -2 SD but not more than -3 SD from mean corrected for age and sex.

HP:0004060.name: Trident hand
HP:0004060.definition: A hand in which the fingers are of nearly equal length and deflected at the first interphalangeal joint, so as to give a forklike shape consisting of separation of the first and second as well as the third and fourth digits.

HP:0008450.name: Narrow vertebral interpedicular distance
HP:0008450.definition: A reduction of the distance between vertebral pedicles, which are the two short, thick processes, which project backward, one on either side, from the upper part of the vertebral body, at the junction of its posterior and lateral surfaces.

HP:0008873.name: Disproportionate short-limb short stature
HP:0008873.definition: A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short limbs but an average-sized trunk.

HP:0008905.name: Rhizomelia
HP:0008905.definition: Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of limbs (i.e. the femur and humerus).
synonyms: Disproportionately short upper portion of limb

HP:0009381.name: Short finger
HP:0009381.definition: Abnormally short finger associated with developmental hypoplasia.

HP:0009826.name: Limb undergrowth
HP:0009826.definition: Limb shortening because of underdevelopment of one or more bones of the extremities.
synonyms: Hypoplasia involving bones of the extremities

HP:0040194.definition: An abnormally increased head circumference in a growing child. Head circumference is measured with a nonelastic tape and comprises the distance from above the eyebrows and ears and around the back of the head. The measured HC is then plotted on an appropriate growth chart.

HP:0100864.name: Short femoral neck
HP:0100864.definition: An abnormally short femoral neck (which is the process of bone, connecting the femoral head with the femoral shaft).

HP:0001027.definition: A skin texture that is unusually soft (and may feel silky), and has a malleable consistency resembling that of dough.

HP:0001030.definition: Skin that splits easily with minimal injury.

HP:0001058.definition: A reduced ability to heal cutaneous wounds.

HP:0001166.definition: Abnormally long and slender fingers (spider fingers).

HP:0001249.definition: The term intellectual disability or intellectual developmental disorder is used to describe significantly sub-average intellectual and adaptive functioning based on clinical assessment and as measured by individually administered, appropriately normed, standardized and validated tests of intellectua

HP:0001252.name: Hypotonia
HP:0001252.definition: Hypotonia is an abnormally low muscle tone (the amount of tension or resistance to movement in a muscle). Even when relaxed, muscles have a continuous and passive partial contraction which provides some resistance to passive stretching. Hypotonia thus manifests as diminished resistance to passive st

HP:0001270.name: Motor delay
HP:0001270.definition: A type of Developmental delay characterized by a delay in acquiring motor skills.
synonyms: Delay in development of motor milestones

HP:0001271.name: Polyneuropathy
HP:0001271.definition: A generalized disorder of peripheral nerves.

HP:0001382.name: Joint hypermobility
HP:0001382.definition: The capability that a joint (or a group of joints) has to move, passively and/or actively, beyond normal limits along physiological axes.

HP:0001537.name: Umbilical hernia
HP:0001537.definition: Protrusion of abdominal contents through a defect in the abdominal wall musculature around the umbilicus. Skin and subcutaneous tissue overlie the defect.

HP:0001582.name: Redundant skin
HP:0001582.definition: Loose and sagging skin often associated with loss of skin elasticity.

HP:0001596.name: Alopecia
HP:0001596.definition: A noncongenital process of hair loss, which may progress to partial or complete baldness.

HP:0001622.name: Premature birth
HP:0001622.definition: The birth of a baby of less than 37 weeks of gestational age.

HP:0001634.name: Mitral valve prolapse
HP:0001634.definition: One or both of the leaflets (cusps) of the mitral valve bulges back into the left atrium upon contraction of the left ventricle.

HP:0001760.name: Abnormal foot morphology
HP:0001760.definition: An abnormality of the skeleton of foot.

HP:0001763.name: Pes planus
HP:0001763.definition: A foot where the longitudinal arch of the foot is in contact with the ground or floor when the individual is standing; or, in a patient lying supine, a foot where the arch is in contact with the surface of a flat board pressed against the sole of the foot by the examiner with a pressure similar to t

HP:0001765.name: Hammertoe
HP:0001765.definition: Hyperextension of the metatarsal-phalangeal joint with hyperflexion of the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joint.

HP:0001822.name: Hallux valgus
HP:0001822.definition: Lateral deviation of the great toe (i.e., in the direction of the little toe).

HP:0001852.name: Sandal gap
HP:0001852.definition: A widely spaced gap between the first toe (the great toe) and the second toe.
synonyms: Gap between first and second toe
Increased space between first and second toes

HP:0001999.name: Abnormal facial shape
HP:0001999.definition: An abnormal morphology (form) of the face or its components.

HP:0002020.name: Gastroesophageal reflux
HP:0002020.definition: A condition in which the stomach contents leak backwards from the stomach into the esophagus through the lower esophageal sphincter.

HP:0002098.name: Respiratory distress
HP:0002098.definition: Respiratory distress is objectively observable as the physical or emotional consequences from the experience of dyspnea. The physical presentation of respiratory distress is generally referred to as labored breathing, while the sensation of respiratory distress is called shortness of breath or dyspn

HP:0002312.name: Clumsiness
HP:0002312.definition: Lack of physical coordination resulting in an abnormal tendency to drop items or bump into objects.

HP:0002460.name: Distal muscle weakness
HP:0002460.definition: Reduced strength of the musculature of the distal extremities.
synonyms: Distal limb muscle weakness due to peripheral neuropathy

HP:0002616.name: Aortic root aneurysm
HP:0002616.definition: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the aortic root.
synonyms: Bulge in wall of root of large artery that carries blood away from heart

HP:0002638.name: Superficial thrombophlebitis
HP:0002638.definition: Inflammation of a superficial vein associated with venous thrombosis (blood clot formation within the vein).

HP:0002650.name: Scoliosis
HP:0002650.definition: The presence of an abnormal lateral curvature of the spine.
synonyms: Cobb angle greater than ten degrees

HP:0002761.name: Generalized joint hypermobility
HP:0002761.definition: Joint hypermobility (ability of a joint to move beyond its normal range of motion) affecting many or all joints of the body. In individuals with Joint hypermobility at multiple sites (usually five or more), the term generalized joint hypermobility is preferred.

HP:0003177.name: Squared iliac bones
HP:0003177.definition: A shift from the normally round (convex) appearance of the iliac wing towards a square-like appearance.

HP:0003418.name: Back pain
HP:0003418.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the back.

HP:0003549.name: Abnormality of connective tissue
HP:0003549.definition: Any abnormality of the soft tissues, including both connective tissue (tendons, ligaments, fascia, fibrous tissues, and fat).

HP:0003552.name: Muscle stiffness
HP:0003552.definition: A condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm.

HP:0004417.name: Intermittent claudication
HP:0004417.definition: Intermittent claudication is a symptom of peripheral arterial occlusive disease. After having walked over a distance which is individually characteristic, the patients experience pain or cramps in the calves, feet or thighs which typically subsides on standing still.

HP:0004484.name: Craniofacial asymmetry
HP:0004484.definition: Asymmetry of the bones of the skull and the face.

HP:0004950.name: Peripheral arterial stenosis
HP:0004950.definition: Narrowing of peripheral arteries with reduction of blood flow to the limbs. This feature may be quantified as an ankle-brachial index of less than 0.9, and may be manifested clinically as claudication.

HP:0006829.name: Severe muscular hypotonia
HP:0006829.definition: A severe degree of muscular hypotonia characterized by markedly reduced muscle tone.

HP:0007010.name: Poor fine motor coordination
HP:0007010.definition: An abnormality of the ability (skills) to perform a precise movement of small muscles with the intent to perform a specific act. Fine motor skills are required to mediate movements of the wrists, hands, fingers, feet, and toes.

HP:0011123.name: Inflammatory abnormality of the skin
HP:0011123.definition: The presence of inflammation of the skin. That is, an abnormality of the skin resulting from the local accumulation of fluid, plasma proteins, and leukocytes.
synonyms: Abnormal tendency to infections of the skin

HP:0012378.name: Fatigue
HP:0012378.definition: A subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation.

HP:0012432.name: Chronic fatigue
HP:0012432.definition: Subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation that persists for six months or longer.

HP:0012531.name: Pain
HP:0012531.definition: An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience associated with actual or potential tissue damage, or described in terms of such damage.

HP:0020110.name: Bone fracture
HP:0020110.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the continuity of a bone.

HP:0025014.name: Subcutaneous spheroids
HP:0025014.definition: Small, hard cyst-like nodules, freely moveable in the subcutis over the bony prominences of the legs and arms, which have an outer calcified layer with a translucent core on x-ray.

HP:0025406.name: Asthenia
HP:0025406.definition: A state characterized by a feeling of weakness and loss of strength leading to a generalized weakness of the body.

HP:0030881.name: Shoulder impingement
HP:0030881.definition: Trapping and compression of the rotator cuff tendons during shoulder movements.

HP:0031364.name: Ecchymosis
HP:0031364.definition: A purpuric lesion that is larger than 1 cm in diameter.

HP:0034033.name: Peripheral cyanosis
HP:0034033.definition: Bluish discoloration of the distal extremities in the absence of cold temperature or stress. Peripheral cyanosis can involve hands, fingertips, or toes, and sometimes circumoral and periorbital areas. Mucous membranes are generally not involved.

HP:0100699.name: Scarring
HP:0100699.definition: A scar refers to a lesion in which wound, burn, or sore has not healed completely and fibrous connective tissue has developed.

HP:0200034.name: Papule
HP:0200034.definition: A circumscribed, solid elevation of skin with no visible fluid, varying in size from a pinhead to less than 10mm in diameter at the widest point.

HP:5200339.name: Self-cutting
HP:5200339.definition: Deliberate harm to one's body, in the form of cutting that results in tissue damage, without a conscious intent to die.

HP:5210430.name: Hindfoot deformity
HP:5210430.definition: A structural deformity of the hindfoot, the posterior region of the foot formed by the talus and calcaneus.

HP:6001274.name: Thumb sign
HP:6001274.definition: The distal phalanx of the adducted thumb extends beyond the ulnar border of the palm (The thumb protrudes from the clenched fist).

HP:6001376.name: Forefoot pain
HP:6001376.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized about the metatarsal heads in the front part of the foot.

HP:0001627.name: Abnormal heart morphology
HP:0001627.definition: Any structural anomaly of the heart.

HP:0001635.name: Congestive heart failure
HP:0001635.definition: The presence of an abnormality of cardiac function that is responsible for the failure of the heart to pump blood at a rate that is commensurate with the needs of the tissues or a state in which abnormally elevated filling pressures are required for the heart to do so. HP:0001638.name: Cardiomyopathy
HP:0001638.definition: A myocardial disorder in which the heart muscle is structurally and functionally abnormal, in the absence of coronary artery disease, hypertension, valvular disease and congenital heart disease sufficient to cause the observed myocardial abnormality.

HP:0001639.name: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
HP:0001639.definition: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is defined by the presence of increased ventricular wall thickness or mass in the absence of loading conditions (hypertension, valve disease) sufficient to cause the observed abnormality.

HP:0001640.name: Cardiomegaly
HP:0001640.definition: Increased size of the heart, clinically defined as an increased transverse diameter of the cardiac silhouette that is greater than or equal to 50% of the transverse diameter of the chest (increased cardiothoracic ratio) on a posterior-anterior projection of a chest radiograph or a computed tomograph

HP:0001644.name: Dilated cardiomyopathy
HP:0001644.definition: Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is defined by the presence of left ventricular dilatation and left ventricular systolic dysfunction in the absence of abnormal loading conditions (hypertension, valve disease) or coronary artery disease sufficient to cause global systolic impairment. HP:0001706.name: Endocardial fibroelastosis
HP:0001706.definition: Diffuse thickening of the ventricular endocardium and by associated myocardial dysfunction

HP:0001945.name: Fever
HP:0001945.definition: Body temperature elevated above the normal range.

HP:0002088.name: Abnormal lung morphology
HP:0002088.definition: Any structural anomaly of the lung.

HP:0006685.name: Endocardial fibrosis
HP:0006685.definition: The presence of excessive connective tissue in the endocardium.

HP:0011025.name: Abnormal cardiovascular system physiology
HP:0011025.definition: Abnormal functionality of the cardiovascular system.

HP:0034376.name: Atrioventricular valve regurgitation
HP:0034376.definition: Regurgitation of a heart valve that controls blood flow from a an atrium to a ventricle, including mitral, tricuspid, or, rarely, single atrioventicular valve.

HP:0100584.name: Endocarditis
HP:0100584.definition: An inflammation of the endocardium, the inner layer of the heart, which usually involves the heart valves.

HP:0000988.name: Skin rash
HP:0000988.definition: A red eruption of the skin.

HP:0001263.name: Global developmental delay
HP:0001263.definition: A delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child, including motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and emotional skills. This term should only be used to describe children younger than five years of age.

HP:0001888.name: Decreased total lymphocyte count
HP:0001888.definition: A reduced number of lymphocytes in the blood.

HP:0001903.name: Anemia
HP:0001903.definition: A reduction in erythrocytes volume or hemoglobin concentration.

HP:0001924.name: Sideroblastic anemia
HP:0001924.definition: Sideroblastic anemia results from a defect in the incorporation of iron into the heme molecule. A sideroblast is an erythroblast that has stainable deposits of iron in cytoplasm (this can be demonstrated by Prussian blue staining).

HP:0001945.name: Fever
HP:0001945.definition: Body temperature elevated above the normal range.

HP:0001954.name: Recurrent fever
HP:0001954.definition: Periodic (episodic or recurrent) bouts of fever.

HP:0002719.name: Recurrent infections
HP:0002719.definition: Increased susceptibility to infections as manifested by repeated bouts of infection.

HP:0002721.name: Immunodeficiency
HP:0002721.definition: Failure of the immune system to protect the body adequately from infection, due to the absence or insufficiency of some component process or substance.

HP:0008064.name: Ichthyosis
HP:0008064.definition: An abnormality of the skin characterized the presence of excessive amounts of dry surface scales on the skin resulting from an abnormality of keratinization.

HP:0010976.name: Decreased total B cell count
HP:0010976.definition: The absolute number of B cells in the blood, per microlitre is below the lower limit of normal of the reference range for the appropriate sex and age-group.

HP:0011034.name: Amyloid deposition
HP:0011034.definition: Pathologic deposits of specific fibrillar protein aggregates with distinct microscopic properties, particularly affinity for the dye Congo red with typical birefringence.

HP:0011123.name: Inflammatory abnormality of the skin
HP:0011123.definition: The presence of inflammation of the skin. That is, an abnormality of the skin resulting from the local accumulation of fluid, plasma proteins, and leukocytes.
synonyms: Abnormal tendency to infections of the skin

HP:0012219.name: Erythema nodosum
HP:0012219.definition: An erythematous eruption commonly associated with drug reactions or infection and characterized by inflammatory nodules that are usually tender, multiple, and bilateral.

HP:0032323.name: Periodic fever
HP:0032323.definition: Episodic fever that recurs at regular intervals.

HP:6001166.name: Spongiosis
HP:6001166.definition: Spongiosis refers to the increased intercellular edema in the epidermis resulting in the pulling away of the keratinocytes from their surrounding desmosomes. HP:0001288.name: Gait disturbance
HP:0001288.definition: The term gait disturbance can refer to any disruption of the ability to walk.

HP:0001297.name: Stroke
HP:0001297.definition: Sudden impairment of blood flow to a part of the brain due to occlusion or rupture of an artery to the brain.

HP:0001596.name: Alopecia
HP:0001596.definition: A noncongenital process of hair loss, which may progress to partial or complete baldness.

HP:0002140.name: Ischemic stroke
HP:0002140.definition: Acute ischemic stroke (AIS) is defined by the sudden loss of blood flow to an area of the brain with the resulting loss of neurologic function. HP:0002352.name: Leukoencephalopathy
HP:0002352.definition: This term describes abnormality of the white matter of the cerebrum resulting from damage to the myelin sheaths of nerve cells.

HP:0002500.name: Abnormal cerebral white matter morphology
HP:0002500.definition: An abnormality of the cerebral white matter.
synonyms: Abnormality of the cerebral white matter

HP:0003077.name: Hyperlipidemia
HP:0003077.definition: An elevated lipid concentration in the blood.

HP:0003690.name: Limb muscle weakness
HP:0003690.definition: Reduced strength and weakness of the muscles of the arms and legs.

HP:0025012.name: Status cribrosum
HP:0025012.definition: Diffusely widened perivascular spaces in the basal ganglia, affecting especially the corpus striatum. Status cribrosum is usually symmetrical, with the perivascular spaces showing CSF signal and without diffusion restriction. The word cribriform means sievelike, with multiple perforations.

HP:0100543.name: Cognitive impairment
HP:0100543.definition: Abnormal cognition is characterized by deficits in thinking, reasoning, or remembering.
